stem:
Jatin has drawn base $AB$ of length $6\,\mathrm{cm}$. He must build triangle $ABC$ with $AC = 5\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $BC = 4\,\mathrm{cm}$.

Which two claims correctly decide where to place point $C$?

options.text: Place $C$ anywhere on a single arc drawn from $A$ alone.
Draw an arc centred at $A$ with radius $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ and an arc centred at $B$ with radius $4\,\mathrm{cm}$.
Place $C$ at a meeting point of those two arcs.
Place $C$ at the darkest printed midpoint mark on segment $AB$.

teacher.key_rationale: The third vertex is an intersection of the two radius arcs from the base endpoints. One arc alone omits the second side length; the midpoint mark on AB is not the third vertex.
